title: Maximum Interval Overlap
summary: Return the largest number of half-open intervals active simultaneously.
statement: Return the largest number of half-open intervals active simultaneously. Implement `maximum_interval_overlap` and return the required result without changing the callable signature.
constraints: Inputs follow the declared Python and JSON-compatible types.
Return a deterministic result for every valid input.
hints: At equal times, half-open intervals end before others start.
Sort start and end events with end events first, then track active count.
Pseudocode checkpoint: identify the state, update it once per step, and return only after the maximum_interval_overlap invariant is complete.
Editorial: Sort start and end events with end events first, then track active count. The intended bounds are O(n log n) time and O(n) space.
